page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Below the text, a dedication block with the title centred and the dedicatee's address set in a hanging-indented block. Signature "XX" at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: servantiam cohortandum conferre poterimus, non patiemur quicquam in nobis desiderari.

Atque haec hoc tempore ad literas & Legationis capita R. D.F. respondere visum fuit, cui diuturnam valetudinem, & in vera Religione constantiam, gubernationem tranquillam, rerumque successus prosperrimos ex animo precamur.
main_text.head: GEORGIUS FREDERICUS.
main_text.p: Serenissimo Principi a Domino, Domino Henrico Navarrorum Regi, &c. Dei gratia Fredericus Marchio Brandenburgensis in Prussia, Pomeraniae, Cassubiorum & Slavorum, nec non Silesiae Carnoviae, &c. Dux, Burgravius Norimbergensis ac Rugiae Princeps.

page.notes: Several words are worn and doubtful in the scan, notably "Regiomonte", "Prussia" and the names in the dedication, which are transcribed as best read. The running head and the dedication lines are set in mixed type and may contain small errors. The page number "141" is read from the top right and may be partly damaged.
